notes.title: We hear you!
notes.content:
[b]🚀 Exciting News! [/b]

You asked, we listened! 

We've just released a new version of Die Last, packed with optimizations and fixes! Check out the new features:

- Mute Sounds Button
- Improved SDK Config
- SDK Retries
- Smoother Gameplay (no more relogging, just a route reset)

Your sound might be off, but ours is always on for you and your feedback! Keep sharing your awesome ideas and enjoy the game with the new features 🌎
